Definition: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about; 1a) through (of action); 1b) behind (with verbs of shutting); 1c) about (with verbs of fencing); 1d) on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
